resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 8,252 ft (2,515 m) and firelookout.com gives 8261 ft. The story uses the NHLR figure, which matches the record's elevation_m.
The survey cover says Big Piney Ranger District, while the survey text says Hoback Ranger District. The story follows the text, and the record does not depend on either.

notes_for_editor: The 1941 CCC build and precut log method rest on the USFS survey (Volume II evaluations, cover photo credited to the USFS). Current status rests on firelookout.com's undated 'Still there'. Not read: a Flickr photo page (search snippet calls it abandoned; not used), and the Living New Deal page (403 Forbidden). The westlookouts 1941 item describes four CCC lookout houses, 12 feet square; the story does not tie those to this site, and the survey supports the 1941 build on its own. The record has no height_m for this site, and none was found in these sources. No staffing after 1954 was found. No photos added: the NHLR credits SingleTracks.com but gives no license.
